tasks.description: TEMPORARY GPT-5.5 SOLO SELF-REVIEW / OPENED-DEVELOPMENT SOURCE242 CLOSED-LOOP MICROCONTINUATION AFTER T-C2G. T-C2 proved the repaired v34z2 objective contract for converged canonical H12/H15/H35 source242 single decisions; S-TC2G then showed H15 V15_shared initialization-basin brittleness: alpha=0.25 between canonical and goal-facing converged with zero slack, while alpha=0.50, alpha=0.75 and the prior alpha=1.0 goal-facing anchor returned Infeasible_Problem_Detected with large slack/epsilon penalties but exact full objective reconstruction. The next useful bounded action is to stop spending solver calls on metadata-only gate refinements and obtain a small actual control/timing comparison from the same opened development branch. After verifying an external backup covering S-TC2G source/artifacts/docs/registry/state, implement and run a closed-loop branch microcontinuation on source242_slot0_branch_start using only the opened development case: arms H in [12,15,35], terminal mode V15_shared held fixed to match the objective-contract gate, ordinary deployment-style controller warm-start after the first action, canonical/zero-control first-iteration initialization only if an explicit initial primal must be set, and no goal-facing initialization. Each arm runs from the identical branch state and shifted TVP for at most 60 plant steps or until success/constraint/terminal/failure. Record per-step state/control, physical/control/constraint/total cost components, success and constraint flags, initial/final/step solver failures, solver return statuses/iterations, actual solver wall time, whole-decision wall time including controller overhead, first-control hashes, terminal/value metadata, and prefix/source context hashes. Stop immediately on validation64/sealed-test access, non-source242 context mismatch, hidden env reset that changes the branch state, or budget cap. This is development evidence only and cannot establish population validation, final acceptance, or a fair fixed-H result; it only tests whether the repaired source242 setup produces meaningful closed-loop differences under the objective-contract-safe initialization regime.
tasks.method: three-arm source242 fixed-H closed-loop microcontinuation with H=[12,15,35], V15_shared terminal held fixed, canonical/default warm-start, max 60 plant steps per arm, full cost/safety/solver/timing traces
